US Lawmakers, Families Urge Release of Detained Americans Ahead of Xi Visit

Ahead of a meeting between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping, US lawmakers and families of detained Americans are urging for the release of their loved ones. Some lawmakers are also calling for curbs on China's artificial intelligence development. Families have directly pressed for the release of individuals held in China.
